quests.instruction: Listen for the deadline the team actually has to meet.
quests.hint: The client's deadline and the internal deadline are different. Follow the final summary.
quests.explanation: Thursday at five is correct. Friday is the client's deadline, but the team must finish earlier.
quests.textToSpeak: Is the report due on Friday? No, Thursday. Well, the client said Friday, but our manager wants it a day earlier so she can review it. So, Thursday at five.

quests.instruction: Wipe the glass and tap what you get if you don't pay the difference.
quests.hint: ‘Otherwise’ points to the alternative when the condition isn't met.
quests.explanation: Correct: a voucher. A Sunday seat requires paying the extra money.
quests.textToSpeak: The flight's canceled, so they've put us on the Sunday one, but only if we pay the difference, which is about a hundred and twenty. Otherwise it's a voucher for a later trip.

quests.instruction: Notice where HR is now.
quests.hint: The speaker answers from memory and then corrects it. ‘Now’ points to the answer.
quests.explanation: The answer is the second floor. The third floor was HR's old location.
quests.textToSpeak: Which floor is HR on? The third. No, sorry, they moved last month. They're on the second now, next to the print room.

quests.instruction: Find the return limit for electronics.
quests.hint: A general rule and two exceptions are given. Match the item to the exception.
quests.explanation: 15 days is correct. Thirty days is the general rule, and sale items can't be returned at all.
quests.textToSpeak: Returns are accepted within thirty days, with two exceptions: sale items, which are final, and electronics, which have a fifteen-day limit.

quests.instruction: Catch what visitors behind the yellow line must wear.
quests.hint: There is a general rule and an exception for one group. Which group are you listening for?
quests.explanation: Safety glasses is correct. The helmet requirement applies to everyone else.
quests.textToSpeak: Everyone should wear a helmet in the workshop, except visitors who stay behind the yellow line. For them, safety glasses are enough.

quests.instruction: Pick out when the store closes on Sundays.
quests.hint: There is a normal time and two exceptions. One exception is a different time, and one is a closure.
quests.explanation: 6:00 is correct. Nine is the usual closing time.
quests.textToSpeak: The store is open until nine every day, except Sundays, when it closes at six, and holidays, when it doesn't open at all.

quests.instruction: Focus on who created the file.
quests.hint: The file passes through several people. Creating is different from sending or forwarding.
quests.explanation: Chen is correct. Beatriz only forwarded the file.
quests.textToSpeak: I thought Ahmed sent the file. He said Beatriz did. She said she only forwarded it, and it was actually Chen who created it.

quests.instruction: Wipe the glass, then tap who is camping.
quests.hint: Each person has a different type of accommodation. Match the activity to the name.
quests.explanation: The answer is Ravi. Tom is at the hotel, and Ana is with her cousin.
quests.textToSpeak: So Tom's staying at the hotel, and Ana is at her cousin's place. Ravi is camping, and the rest of us are sharing the apartment near the station.

quests.instruction: Listen for who will join by video.
quests.hint: Someone changed from a planned role to a limited one. Follow the person who is unwell.
quests.explanation: Correct: Professor Silva. Dr. Kwon is now presenting the results.
quests.textToSpeak: Dr. Ellis will chair the panel, and Dr. Kwon will present the results. Professor Silva, who was supposed to present, is unwell and will only join by video.

quests.instruction: Wipe away the fog and tap what the space is becoming.
quests.hint: The old use and the future use are different. Listen for ‘converted into’.
quests.explanation: A bank is correct. It used to be a bakery.
quests.textToSpeak: The bakery on the corner has been closed since March, and the space is being converted into a bank, although nobody knows when it'll open.

quests.instruction: Listen for how long a decision takes if no extra information is needed.
quests.hint: There are two possibilities. ‘Otherwise’ leads to the second one.
quests.explanation: Within a month is correct. Ten working days is the deadline for extra questions.
quests.textToSpeak: Your application has been received and is under review. If we need more information, we'll email you within ten working days. Otherwise you'll get a decision within a month.

quests.instruction: Tap who can let you use the service lift.
quests.hint: The person with access is named in the middle of the sentence.
quests.explanation: The answer is the staff. They can open the service lift for people who can't use the stairs.
quests.textToSpeak: The lift is out of order until Wednesday, but there's a service lift at the back which staff can let you use if you can't manage the stairs.

quests.instruction: Notice what the speaker had to do after the film.
quests.hint: The speaker explains why a short film was good news.
quests.explanation: Correct: catch the last train. A short film gave the speaker enough time.
quests.textToSpeak: The film was a lot shorter than I expected, only about ninety minutes, which was a relief because I had to catch the last train.

quests.instruction: Find who earns the most.
quests.hint: Order the three people from highest to lowest earnings.
quests.explanation: Correct: her brother. She earns less than him and more than her sister.
quests.textToSpeak: She earns less than her brother, who's a consultant, but more than her sister, who's a teacher.

quests.instruction: Listen for how long the trip actually took.
quests.hint: The expected time and the real time are different. Roadworks explain the difference.
quests.explanation: The answer is nearly six hours. Four hours was the promised time.
quests.textToSpeak: We were told the trip would take four hours, but with the roadworks it took nearly six, and we arrived long after the ceremony had started.

quests.instruction: Wipe the glass and tap how many people the booking is for.
quests.hint: The speaker says ‘sorry’ and fixes a number. Which number stays?
quests.explanation: 5 is correct. Four is corrected by the speaker, and seven is the time.
quests.textToSpeak: The booking is for Mr. Pereira at seven, for four people. Sorry, five. His mother is joining us.

quests.instruction: Listen for the second bus you should take.
quests.hint: A wrong number is corrected, and the reason is given.
quests.explanation: 40 is correct. The fourteen doesn't run on weekends. Nine is the first bus.
quests.textToSpeak: Take the number nine to the market, then change to the fourteen. No, the forty, because the fourteen doesn't run on weekends.

quests.instruction: Tap the correct house number.
quests.hint: The two numbers have the same digits in reverse order. Listen to the correction.
quests.explanation: The answer is 21. Twelve is the old address.
quests.textToSpeak: The delivery address is twelve Oak Lane. Actually, no, that's my old address. It's twenty-one Oak Lane.

quests.instruction: Listen for what happens if the rain chance is higher.
quests.hint: ‘Otherwise’ describes the alternative when the condition fails.
quests.explanation: They move indoors is correct. The hall is the backup plan.
quests.textToSpeak: We'll go ahead with the outdoor event only if the forecast shows less than a twenty percent chance of rain. Otherwise we move everything into the hall.

quests.instruction: Tap what students need to keep the scholarship.
quests.hint: The scholarship's coverage and its renewal rule are different.
quests.explanation: Correct: an average above B. Tuition and books are what it pays for.
quests.textToSpeak: The scholarship covers tuition and books, but not accommodation. Students who maintain above a B average keep it for the second year.

quests.instruction: Listen for when it finally arrived.
quests.hint: Two promises are broken. Wait for ‘finally’.
quests.explanation: The fifth and ninth were only promises. So the answer is the 11th.
quests.textToSpeak: The vendor promised delivery by the fifth, then the ninth, and it finally arrived on the eleventh.

quests.instruction: Wipe the glass, then tap how long the speaker will be in a cast.
quests.hint: The diagnosis changed and so did the time. Focus on the final treatment.
quests.explanation: Two weeks was the original estimate, before the X-ray. So the answer is six weeks.
quests.textToSpeak: Initially the doctor thought it was a sprain, but the X-ray showed a small fracture, so I'll be in a cast for six weeks instead of the two I was told.

quests.instruction: Listen for how many people attended in total.
quests.hint: The expected number is not the real one. Add the two groups that actually came.
quests.explanation: Ninety registered guests plus forty walk-ins gives one hundred thirty. So the answer is 130.
quests.textToSpeak: We expected a hundred and fifty attendees. About ninety people registered in advance and all of them came, and another forty showed up on the day.

quests.instruction: Wipe the glass and tap who is responsible for the repair now.
quests.hint: Responsibility moved from one party to another. Find the new one.
quests.explanation: Correct: the management company. The landlord passed the job on.
quests.textToSpeak: The landlord said he'd repair the heater himself, but when the tenant asked for a date, he said it was up to the management company, who haven't replied.

quests.instruction: Listen for what you need to do about lunch on the second day.
quests.hint: The first day is different from the second. Focus on the second day.
quests.explanation: Arrange your own lunch is correct. On day two, lunch is not provided.
quests.textToSpeak: Lunch is provided on the first day, but on the second day you'll need to bring your own or use the café, which is only open until one thirty.

quests.instruction: Wipe the glass and tap what has not changed.
quests.hint: One detail changes and another stays the same. Listen for ‘hasn't changed’.
quests.explanation: The start time is correct. Only the venue is different.
quests.textToSpeak: Please note that the concert is now at the Harbor Hall rather than the City Arena, though the start time hasn't changed.

quests.instruction: Listen for which place is closer.
quests.hint: Two distances are compared. Smaller means closer.
quests.explanation: Correct: the beach. Three kilometers is shorter than five.
quests.textToSpeak: It's three kilometers to the beach and five to the town center, so the beach is quicker to reach on foot.

quests.instruction: Wipe the glass and tap when the slides were finished.
quests.hint: A promise was made, then the situation changed. What actually happened?
quests.explanation: Friday is correct. Monday was the original promise.
quests.textToSpeak: You said you'd finish the slides by Monday. I did say that, but then the client moved the presentation up, so I finished them on Friday instead.

quests.instruction: Listen for what the speaker wants to avoid.
quests.hint: The speaker is flexible in general but has a limit. Listen for ‘as long as’.
quests.explanation: Vegetarian options are something the speaker wants, not something to avoid. So the answer is noise.
quests.textToSpeak: I don't mind which restaurant we go to, as long as it isn't too noisy and has some vegetarian options.

quests.instruction: Spot who won the fiction prize.
quests.hint: Each winner has a category. Match the category to the name.
quests.explanation: Yuki won poetry, and Lena won the essay prize. So the answer is Omar.
quests.textToSpeak: The prize was shared by three people: Yuki, who won the poetry section, Omar, who won for fiction, and Lena, who took the essay prize.
